items.summary: Hi HN, I've built Rui (cotton in hindi), an agent runtime built for memory efficiency. The main design choice is that sessions share a host rather than each being a process. Agents are state in DB and the host handles the active work through a share event loop. LLMs are getting better at coordination and teams (swarms) of agents are coming. Memory is getting expensive and my machine is always using swap. We cannot be wasting hundreds of MBs of RAM for an orchestrator (AKA the harness) of LLMs and tools. More information on the architecture and measurement methodology is at https://divyanshgoly

It's extremely configurable, even down to the search weights, and comes packed with CLI/MCP if you want to use it with an agent. This is my daily driver for email, but it's by no means a "stable" product. Use at your own risk. I'm also working on a mobile app to go along with it. Enjoy.
